# DebuggAI

> > DebuggAI provides AI-powered automated browser testing for GitHub pull requests with zero configuration.

DebuggAI integrates with GitHub workflows to automatically generate and run end-to-end browser tests using AI for every pull request. The platform supports Playwright and Selenium, offers MCP Server integration for Claude Desktop, and includes DebuggAI PR Copilot for intelligent test generation.

## Key Topics

- DebuggAI PR Copilot
- GitHub integration
- Playwright
- Selenium
- AI-powered testing
- E2E testing
- Pull request automation
- Zero-config testing
- MCP Server

- Browser automation
